description: Source code for Brave web search provider plugin, including API integrations, configuration resolution, search execution, and result processing.

methods.name: resolveBraveConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Brave configuration from search config, returning mode setting.

methods.name: resolveBraveMode
methods.description: Determines whether the mode is 'web' or 'llm-context' based on config.

methods.name: resolveBraveApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Brave API key from config or environment variables.

methods.name: normalizeBraveSearchLang
methods.description: Normalizes and validates the Brave search language code.

methods.name: normalizeBraveCountry
methods.description: Normalizes and validates the country code, defaulting to 'ALL' if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeBraveUiLang
methods.description: Normalizes UI language locale code to language-region format.

methods.name: normalizeBraveLanguageParams
methods.description: Normalizes search_lang and ui_lang parameters, checking for validity.

methods.name: mapBraveLlmContextResults
methods.description: Maps raw LLM context API results to structured result objects.

methods.name: runBraveLlmContextSearch
methods.description: Performs a Brave LLM context API search with given parameters.

methods.name: runBraveWebSearch
methods.description: Performs a Brave web search API call with specified parameters.

methods.name: createBraveSchema
methods.description: Defines the schema for Brave search parameters.

methods.name: missingBraveKeyPayload
methods.description: Returns error payload when API key is missing.

methods.name: createBraveToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates the search tool definition with execution logic based on config.

methods.name: createBraveWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Exports the plugin object for Brave web search provider.
